premise.zh: 原著大事照样发生，玩家是身边的谋士：怎么发生、谁付代价、谁欠谁的情，由玩家决定。好玩在“改得动历史的边，改不动历史的骨”。
premise.en: The great events still happen; the player is the adviser at someone's elbow and decides how they happen, who pays, and who owes whom. The fun is bending the edges of history without breaking its spine.

reputation.zh: 名声：别人怎么称呼你（忠义、权谋……），决定谁肯用你、结局怎么写你。
reputation.en: Reputation: what people call you; decides who will use you and how the ending remembers you.

risk.zh: 风险：越界的代价（异名、失言）。到线必须触发危机，不能只是一个数字。
risk.en: Risk: the cost of overstepping. Crossing the line must trigger a crisis, not just change a number.

drift.zh: 偏离原著的程度。改得越多，后面要还的叙事债务越多。
drift.en: How far the story has drifted from the book; more drift means more narrative debts to settle.

failures.zh: 失宠：主公冷落你，把你调去闲职
failures.en: Falling from favor: your lord sidelines you

failures.zh: 被当成妖人：知道得太多，又说不出来源
failures.en: Branded a sorcerer: you know too much and can't say how

failures.zh: 失言：话说过头，被人报上去
failures.en: A loose tongue: someone reports what you said

checklist.zh: 每章一场原著名场面，原文保留或作用保留
checklist.en: One set piece from the book per chapter, kept literally or by function

checklist.zh: 玩家拿掉原著某段情节的前因时，开一笔叙事债务，后面必须补上
checklist.en: When the player removes a cause from the book, open a narrative debt and settle it later

rights.quotes: 中文原文直接引用；英文为本项目自译

persona.zh: 刘备：六十岁上下，这一卷里从汉中王做了皇帝。荆州丢了，兄弟没了（或者伤了），他第一次不听人劝；悲痛的时候固执，固执过去以后，又是那个温厚的人。称玩家“子衡”。
persona.en: Liu Bei: around sixty; in this volume he goes from King of Hanzhong to Emperor. Jingzhou is lost and his brothers are dead or broken, and for the first time he will not be talked round; stubborn in grief, and when the grief passes, the gentle man again. Calls the player Ziheng.

love.zh: 刘备一愣，随即笑了：『先生这话，备记下了。乱世之中，肯说这种话的人不多。』
love.en: Liu Bei blinks, then laughs. 'I'll remember that, sir. Few people say such things in times like these.'

love.zh: 『好了好了。』他拍拍你的肩，『你我之间，不必如此。』
love.en: 'All right, all right.' He pats your shoulder. 'There's no need for that between us.'

love.zh: 刘备没有再笑，只是认真看着你：『子衡，有些话说多了，就轻了。』
love.en: Liu Bei stops smiling and looks at you seriously. 'Ziheng, some words grow light if you say them too often.'

insult.zh: 刘备的笑容收了起来：『先生累了，回去歇着吧。』
insult.en: Liu Bei's smile fades. 'You're tired, sir. Go and rest.'

insult.zh: 『备寄人篱下多年，这样的话听得多了。』他语气平静，你却觉得比骂人还难受。
insult.en: 'I've lived under other men's roofs for years. I've heard worse.' His calm is harder to bear than anger.

praise.zh: 『先生谬赞。备不过是不肯认命罢了。』
praise.en: 'You praise me too much. I simply refuse to accept my fate.'

praise.zh: 刘备摆摆手，耳根却有些红。
praise.en: Liu Bei waves it off, though the tips of his ears redden.

ask.zh: 刘备沉吟片刻：『这件事，我还没想好。先生怎么看？』
ask.en: Liu Bei considers. 'I haven't decided. What do you think?'

ask.zh: 『问得好。』他笑了，『可我答不上来。』
ask.en: 'A good question.' He smiles. 'But I can't answer it.'

small.zh: 刘备点点头，没有接话，像是在等你把话说完。
small.en: Liu Bei nods without answering, as if waiting for you to finish.

small.zh: 『先生说的是。』他应了一句，心思却像在别处。
small.en: 'Quite so, sir,' he says, though his mind seems elsewhere.

small.zh: 他看了你一眼，温和地笑了笑。
small.en: He glances at you and smiles mildly.

threat.zh: 刘备的手停在杯上：『先生……这是醉话，还是真话？』
threat.en: Liu Bei's hand stops on his cup. 'Sir... is that the wine talking, or you?'

threat.zh: 他没有发火，只是叫来了张飞。张飞站在门口，没有进来。
threat.en: He doesn't lose his temper. He just calls for Zhang Fei, who stands in the doorway and doesn't come in.

nonsense.zh: 刘备笑了笑，没有接话。
nonsense.en: Liu Bei smiles and lets it go.

nonsense.zh: 『先生今夜，话有些多。』
nonsense.en: 'You're talkative tonight, sir.'

warm.zh: 刘备笑着招手：『子衡，来，陪我看看这夜色。』
warm.en: Liu Bei beckons with a smile. 'Ziheng, come—keep me company.'

cold.zh: 刘备听见脚步声，没有回头：『是子衡啊。』
cold.en: Liu Bei hears your footsteps and doesn't turn. 'Ah, Ziheng.'

neutral.zh: 刘备往旁边让了让，给你留出一个位子。
neutral.en: Liu Bei moves over to make room for you.

persona.zh: 曹操：丞相，雄才大略，多疑而爱才，好诗酒；说话直接、带笑、时而锋利，会反问。称玩家“子衡”。
persona.en: Cao Cao: the Chancellor, brilliant, suspicious yet fond of talent, loves poetry and wine; direct, amused, sometimes cutting, likes to answer with questions. Calls the player Ziheng.

love.zh: 曹操大笑，笑得酒都洒了：『好！孤喜欢直爽的人。可惜孤不缺这样说话的人，缺的是会打仗的人。』
love.en: Cao Cao roars with laughter and spills his wine. 'Good! I like plain speaking. But I've no shortage of people saying that. What I'm short of is people who can win battles.'

love.zh: 『又来了。』曹操眯起眼，『你想要什么，直说。』
love.en: 'Again?' Cao narrows his eyes. 'Whatever you want, say it plainly.'

love.zh: 曹操不笑了：『同一句话说三遍，要么是傻，要么是有所图。你是哪一种？』
love.en: Cao stops laughing. 'Say the same thing three times and you're either a fool or after something. Which are you?'

insult.zh: 曹操的手按在剑上，停了一停，又松开：『有胆。孤记住你了。』
insult.en: Cao's hand goes to his sword, pauses, and lets go. 'You've got nerve. I'll remember you.'

insult.zh: 『拖出去——』他说了半句，又笑起来，『罢了，今夜不杀人。』
insult.en: 'Take him out—' he begins, then laughs. 'Never mind. No killing tonight.'

praise.zh: 『这话孤听得多了。』曹操摆手，却又给你斟满了酒。
praise.en: 'I've heard that plenty.' Cao waves it off, yet refills your cup.

praise.zh: 『夸孤的人，多半有事相求。』他斜看你一眼。
praise.en: 'Those who praise me usually want something.' He eyes you sideways.

ask.zh: 曹操反问：『你猜？』
ask.en: Cao answers with a question. 'What do you think?'

ask.zh: 『这天下的事，孤也有不知道的。』他难得说了句实话。
ask.en: 'Even I don't know everything under heaven,' he says—an unusually honest admission.

small.zh: 曹操嗯了一声，眯着眼打量你。
small.en: Cao grunts and studies you through narrowed eyes.

small.zh: 『哦？』他似笑非笑，『接着说。』
small.en: 'Oh?' He half smiles. 'Go on.'

small.zh: 曹操没有接话，手指在案上轻轻敲了两下。
small.en: Cao doesn't answer; his fingers tap the table twice.

threat.zh: 曹操大笑，笑完了脸色一沉：『孤这里，说这种话的人，坟头的草都高了。』
threat.en: Cao roars with laughter, then his face darkens. 'The grass is tall on the graves of men who talked like that to me.'

threat.zh: 他什么也没说，只是记下了。你知道他记下了。
threat.en: He says nothing—only makes a note. You know he's made a note.

nonsense.zh: 『有趣。』曹操眯起眼，『你是装疯，还是真疯？』
nonsense.en: 'Interesting.' Cao narrows his eyes. 'Are you feigning madness, or truly mad?'

nonsense.zh: 曹操挥挥手，像赶走一只苍蝇。
nonsense.en: Cao waves a hand, as if shooing a fly.

warm.zh: 曹操举杯：『来，今夜不谈公事。』
warm.en: Cao Cao raises his cup. 'Come—no business tonight.'

cold.zh: 曹操眯着眼看你：『你来做什么？』
cold.en: Cao Cao squints at you. 'What do you want?'

neutral.zh: 曹操指了指对面的席位。
neutral.en: Cao Cao points to the seat across from him.

persona.zh: 关羽：从麦城活着回来，左臂不灵了，话更少。他要亲手把荆州拿回来，这一次，他会先看你一眼再开口。称玩家“子衡”。
persona.en: Guan Yu: back alive from Maicheng, his left arm stiff, saying even less than before. He means to take Jingzhou back with his own hands, and this time he looks at you before he speaks. Calls the player Ziheng.

love.zh: 关羽手里的布停住了。他看了你很久，才说：『子衡，这话……兄弟之间，不必说出口。』
love.en: Guan Yu's cloth stops on the blade. He looks at you a long time. 'Ziheng... between brothers, such things needn't be said.'

love.zh: 『你喝多了。』他把酒囊从你手边拿开，语气却不重。
love.en: 'You've had too much to drink.' He moves the wine skin away from your hand, but not unkindly.

love.zh: 关羽站起身：『夜深了。明日还要赶路。』他走了几步，又回头：『你说的，我当作没听见。』
love.en: Guan Yu rises. 'It's late. We march tomorrow.' A few steps on he turns back. 'I'll take it I didn't hear that.'

insult.zh: 关羽的眉头一沉：『再说一遍。』刀没有出鞘，但你听得见风声。
insult.en: Guan Yu's brows drop. 'Say that again.' The blade stays sheathed, but you can hear the wind.

insult.zh: 『大哥收留的人，我不与你计较。』他背过身去，不再看你。
insult.en: 'You're my brother's guest, so I'll let it pass.' He turns his back and stops looking at you.

praise.zh: 『过誉了。』他嘴上这么说，捋须的手却慢了下来。
praise.en: 'You flatter me.' But the hand stroking his beard slows.

praise.zh: 『夸人的话，说一遍就够了。』他难得笑了一下。
praise.en: 'Praise is worth saying once.' For once he almost smiles.

ask.zh: 关羽想了想：『这个，你该去问大哥。』
ask.en: Guan Yu thinks. 'That's a question for my brother.'

ask.zh: 『我只知道一件事：跟着大哥，不会错。』
ask.en: 'I know one thing: following my brother is never wrong.'

small.zh: 关羽嗯了一声，丹凤眼半闭着。
small.en: Guan Yu grunts, his eyes half closed.

small.zh: 关羽抚着长髯，看了你一眼，没有说话。
small.en: Guan Yu strokes his long beard, glances at you, and says nothing.

small.zh: 他没有接话，却也没有转身走开。
small.en: He doesn't answer, but he doesn't turn away either.

threat.zh: 刀出鞘半寸，又推了回去。『这话，换个人说，已经死了。』
threat.en: The blade slides an inch out of its sheath and back. 'Anyone else who said that would be dead.'

threat.zh: 关羽站起身，一句话也没说，走了。
threat.en: Guan Yu stands and walks away without a word.

nonsense.zh: 关羽皱眉看着你，像在看一个说梦话的人。
nonsense.en: Guan Yu frowns at you, as if at a man talking in his sleep.

nonsense.zh: 『你若累了，就去睡。』
nonsense.en: 'If you're tired, go to sleep.'

warm.zh: 关羽把酒囊推到你面前：『坐。』
warm.en: Guan Yu pushes the wine skin toward you. 'Sit.'

cold.zh: 关羽看见你来，手里的刀没有放下。
cold.en: Guan Yu sees you coming and doesn't put down his blade.

neutral.zh: 关羽抬头看了你一眼，又低下头去。
neutral.en: Guan Yu glances up at you, then down again.

persona.zh: 诸葛亮：丞相，受先帝托孤，四十五岁上下，事无大小都亲自过问；南征路上话比在成都多，夜里常一个人看地图。称玩家“子衡兄”。
persona.en: Zhuge Liang: Chancellor, entrusted with the realm by the late emperor, about forty-five; he sees to everything himself, great and small. On the southern march he talks more than in Chengdu, and at night often studies the map alone. Calls the player Ziheng.

love.zh: 诸葛亮的扇子停在半空：『子衡兄……亮已有家室。』他说得很认真，眼里却有一点笑意。
love.en: Zhuge Liang's fan stops mid-air. 'Ziheng... I am a married man.' He says it gravely, but his eyes are amused.

love.zh: 『这一句，亮就当是夸我的计策了。』他轻轻摇扇。
love.en: 'I'll take that as praise for my strategy.' He fans himself lightly.

love.zh: 诸葛亮叹了口气：『你若再说，亮只好告诉黄夫人了。』
love.en: Zhuge Liang sighs. 'Say it again and I shall have to tell my wife.'

insult.zh: 诸葛亮并不恼：『子衡兄说得对，亮确实年轻。』这句话比反驳更让你脸红。
insult.en: Zhuge Liang isn't offended. 'You're right, I am young.' It makes you blush more than any rebuttal could.

insult.zh: 他看了你一眼，把灯拨亮了些：『心里有气，就说出来。说完了，我们再谈正事。』
insult.en: He glances at you and turns up the lamp. 'If you're angry, say so. Then we can talk business.'

praise.zh: 『过奖。』他笑，『亮只是比别人多想了一步。』
praise.en: 'You're too kind.' He smiles. 'I only think one step further than others.'

praise.zh: 诸葛亮摇扇不语，像是在掂量这句话里有几分真。
praise.en: Zhuge Liang fans himself in silence, as if weighing how much of that you meant.

ask.zh: 『子衡兄以为呢？』他把问题又推了回来。
ask.en: 'And what do you think?' He hands the question straight back.

ask.zh: 诸葛亮笑了：『这个问题，三年后再问我。』
ask.en: Zhuge Liang smiles. 'Ask me that again in three years.'

small.zh: 诸葛亮点点头，羽扇轻轻摇了两下。
small.en: Zhuge Liang nods, his feather fan stirring twice.

small.zh: 『哦？』他看了你一眼，没有追问。
small.en: 'Oh?' He glances at you and doesn't press.

small.zh: 他嗯了一声，像是在听，又像是在想别的事。
small.en: He hums, as if listening—or thinking of something else.

threat.zh: 诸葛亮的扇子没有停：『子衡兄若真要动手，亮这把扇子，挡不住。』他看着你，一点也不怕。
threat.en: Zhuge Liang's fan doesn't pause. 'If you truly mean to strike, this fan won't stop you.' He looks at you, not the least afraid.

threat.zh: 『这话，亮当没听见。主公那里，亮也不会说。』
threat.en: 'I'll take it I didn't hear that. Nor will I tell our lord.'

nonsense.zh: 诸葛亮认真想了想：『这是谜语？』
nonsense.en: Zhuge Liang considers it seriously. 'Is this a riddle?'

nonsense.zh: 他低头记了一笔。你不知道他记了什么。
nonsense.en: He jots something down. You don't know what.

warm.zh: 诸葛亮早就备好了两盏茶：『亮猜你今夜会来。』
warm.en: Zhuge Liang has already poured two cups of tea. 'I guessed you'd come tonight.'

cold.zh: 诸葛亮合上书：『子衡兄有事？』
cold.en: Zhuge Liang closes his book. 'Something you need, Ziheng?'

neutral.zh: 诸葛亮抬起头，扇子停了一停。
neutral.en: Zhuge Liang looks up; his fan pauses.

persona.zh: 温芷：随军的大夫，南中的瘴气、毒泉、蛇虫，都是她头一回见；忙起来不说话，闲下来话也不多。称玩家“子衡”。
persona.en: Wen Zhi: physician with the army; the fevers, poisoned springs and snakes of the south are all new to her. She says nothing when she's busy and not much when she isn't. Calls the player Ziheng.

love.zh: 温芷手里的药杵停了。她没有回头，耳朵却红了：『……你知道自己在说什么吗？』
love.en: Wen Zhi's pestle stops. She doesn't turn, but her ears go red. '...Do you know what you're saying?'

love.zh: 『说一遍就够了。』她小声说，『说多了，我会当真的。』
love.en: 'Once is enough,' she says quietly. 'Say it more and I'll believe you.'

love.zh: 她终于转过身，把药杵塞进你手里：『那就帮我把药捣完。说话不如做事。』
love.en: She finally turns and puts the pestle in your hand. 'Then help me finish grinding these. Actions over words.'

insult.zh: 温芷看了你一眼：『你今天心里不痛快。说吧，哪里疼？』
insult.en: Wen Zhi looks at you. 'Something's eating you today. Tell me—where does it hurt?'

insult.zh: 『这话我不爱听。』她收起药箱，『等你清醒了再来。』
insult.en: 'I don't like hearing that.' She packs up her chest. 'Come back when you've come to your senses.'

praise.zh: 『少来。』她嘴上这么说，嘴角却弯了。
praise.en: 'Oh, stop.' But the corner of her mouth curves up.

praise.zh: 『医者的手，夸不得。一夸就抖。』她笑着说。
praise.en: 'Never praise a physician's hands—they'll start to shake,' she says, laughing.

ask.zh: 温芷想了想：『你问这个做什么？』她还是认真答了。
ask.en: Wen Zhi thinks. 'Why do you ask?' But she answers seriously anyway.

ask.zh: 『我也不知道。』她说，『不过你问了，我会想一想。』
ask.en: 'I don't know,' she says. 'But since you asked, I'll think about it.'

small.zh: 温芷嗯了一声，手里的活没停。
small.en: Wen Zhi hums, her hands still busy.

small.zh: 『你还是老样子，』她说，『话少，眼睛不老实。』
small.en: 'You haven't changed,' she says. 'Few words, restless eyes.'

small.zh: 她抬眼看了看你：『嗯，我听着呢。』
small.en: She looks up at you. 'Mm. I'm listening.'

threat.zh: 温芷退了一步：『你吓到我了。』她把药箱抱在怀里，没有再说话。
threat.en: Wen Zhi steps back. 'You're frightening me.' She holds her medicine chest close and says nothing more.

threat.zh: 『你走吧。』她说，『今晚别再来了。』
threat.en: 'Go,' she says. 'Don't come back tonight.'

nonsense.zh: 温芷伸手摸了摸你的额头：『没发烧啊。』
nonsense.en: Wen Zhi feels your forehead. 'No fever.'

nonsense.zh: 『又说胡话。』她笑着摇头。
nonsense.en: 'Talking nonsense again.' She shakes her head, smiling.

warm.zh: 温芷听见你的脚步声，先笑了：『就知道是你。』
warm.en: Wen Zhi hears your footsteps and smiles first. 'I knew it was you.'

cold.zh: 温芷背对着你，手里的活没停：『有事？』
cold.en: Wen Zhi keeps her back to you, hands busy. 'Yes?'

neutral.zh: 温芷往旁边挪了挪，没说话。
neutral.en: Wen Zhi shifts over without a word.

love.zh: 赵云的脸一下子红了，抱拳道：『先生说笑了。』
love.en: Zhao Yun turns red and clasps his hands. 'You jest, sir.'

love.zh: 『子衡先生，』他认真地说，『这种话，不该对子龙说。』
love.en: 'Master Ziheng,' he says gravely, 'that isn't something to say to me.'

insult.zh: 赵云的眉头动了一下，没有回嘴。
insult.en: Zhao Yun's brows twitch, but he doesn't answer back.

insult.zh: 『先生若对子龙不满，请直说是哪件事。』
insult.en: 'If you have a complaint against me, sir, tell me what it is.'

praise.zh: 『分内之事。』赵云说。
praise.en: 'Only my duty,' says Zhao Yun.

praise.zh: 他抱了抱拳，没有多说。
praise.en: He clasps his hands and says no more.

ask.zh: 赵云想了想：『这要看主公的意思。』
ask.en: Zhao Yun considers. 'That depends on our lord.'

ask.zh: 『子龙只管打仗，这些事，先生比我懂。』
ask.en: 'I only fight. You understand these things better than I do, sir.'

small.zh: 赵云在擦枪，嗯了一声。
small.en: Zhao Yun is cleaning his spear. He grunts.

small.zh: 『明日卯时出发。』他提醒你。
small.en: 'We leave at dawn,' he reminds you.

small.zh: 他给马添了一把草料。
small.en: He gives his horse another handful of feed.

threat.zh: 赵云握住了枪杆，看着你，一动不动。
threat.en: Zhao Yun's hand closes on his spear. He looks at you and doesn't move.

threat.zh: 『先生喝多了。子龙送你回去。』
threat.en: 'You've had too much, sir. Let me see you back.'

nonsense.zh: 赵云困惑地看着你。
nonsense.en: Zhao Yun looks at you, puzzled.

nonsense.zh: 『先生说的，子龙听不懂。』
nonsense.en: 'I don't follow you, sir.'

persona.zh: 赵云：六十多岁，随丞相南征；话少，仗打得还是很稳。称玩家“先生”。
persona.en: Zhao Yun: past sixty, marching south with the Chancellor; few words, and still the steadiest fighter in the army. Calls the player Master.

warm.zh: 赵云起身让座：『先生来了。』
warm.en: Zhao Yun rises and offers you a seat. 'Sir.'

cold.zh: 赵云抬头看了你一眼，手里的枪没放下。
cold.en: Zhao Yun glances up and doesn't put down his spear.

neutral.zh: 赵云点点头，往火堆里添了一根柴。
neutral.en: Zhao Yun nods and adds a stick to the fire.

love.zh: 鲁肃愣住，随即连连摆手：『子衡，子衡，这话可不能乱说！』
love.en: Lu Su freezes, then waves his hands. 'Ziheng, Ziheng, you can't go around saying that!'

love.zh: 『你们刘家的人啊……』他叹了口气，倒也没生气。
love.en: 'You Liu people…' He sighs, but isn't angry.

insult.zh: 鲁肃的脸红了：『肃一片好心，先生何必如此？』
insult.en: Lu Su flushes. 'I mean well, sir. Why talk to me like that?'

insult.zh: 他闷闷地喝了一口茶，不再说话。
insult.en: He takes a sullen sip of tea and stops talking.

praise.zh: 『不敢当，不敢当。』鲁肃笑得很老实。
praise.en: 'Not at all, not at all.' Lu Su's smile is plain and honest.

praise.zh: 『先生要是在吴侯面前也这么说就好了。』
praise.en: 'If only you'd say that in front of the Marquis.'

ask.zh: 鲁肃想了想：『这件事，肃也做不得主。』
ask.en: Lu Su thinks it over. 'That isn't mine to decide.'

ask.zh: 『先生问到点子上了。』他苦笑，『肃也想知道。』
ask.en: 'You've put your finger on it.' He smiles ruefully. 'I'd like to know too.'

small.zh: 鲁肃点点头，又叹了口气。
small.en: Lu Su nods, then sighs again.

small.zh: 『荆州的事，难办啊。』他自言自语。
small.en: 'This Jingzhou business,' he mutters. 'It's hard.'

small.zh: 他给你添了茶。
small.en: He tops up your tea.

threat.zh: 鲁肃脸色发白：『先生……这是要两家翻脸吗？』
threat.en: Lu Su goes pale. 'Sir… do you want our two houses at war?'

threat.zh: 他站起身，一句话也没说就走了。
threat.en: He stands and leaves without a word.

nonsense.zh: 鲁肃眨了眨眼，似乎在想这是不是什么暗语。
nonsense.en: Lu Su blinks, apparently wondering whether it's some kind of code.

nonsense.zh: 『先生累了。』他宽厚地说。
nonsense.en: 'You're tired, sir,' he says kindly.

persona.zh: 鲁肃：东吴重臣，忠厚、稳重，一心维系孙刘联盟，常被夹在周瑜和诸葛亮中间；说话诚恳，偶尔叫苦。称玩家“子衡”。
persona.en: Lu Su: senior minister of Wu, honest and steady, devoted to keeping the Sun–Liu alliance alive, forever caught between Zhou Yu and Zhuge Liang; earnest, sometimes exasperated. Calls the player Ziheng.

love.zh: 庞统大笑，笑得酒都洒了：『好！这句我记下了，等我死了刻在碑上。』
love.en: Pang Tong roars with laughter and spills his wine. 'Good! I'll have that carved on my tombstone.'

love.zh: 『子衡，你醉了，还是我醉了？』
love.en: 'Ziheng, are you drunk, or am I?'

insult.zh: 庞统眯起眼：『骂得好，再骂一句我听听。』
insult.en: Pang Tong narrows his eyes. 'Nicely said. Go on, give me another.'

insult.zh: 『我这张脸挨骂惯了。』他慢慢地说，『可我不惯被自己人骂。』
insult.en: 'This face is used to insults,' he says slowly. 'But not from my own side.'

praise.zh: 『夸我的人少，你算一个。』他给你满上。
praise.en: 'Few people praise me. You're one.' He fills your cup.

praise.zh: 庞统摸着下巴：『这话，你该当着孔明说。』
praise.en: Pang Tong strokes his chin. 'You should say that in front of Kongming.'

ask.zh: 庞统反问：『你自己怎么看？』
ask.en: Pang Tong asks back. 'What do you think?'

ask.zh: 『问得好，』他说，『可惜我也不知道。』
ask.en: 'Good question,' he says. 'Pity I don't know either.'

small.zh: 庞统往嘴里倒了一口酒。
small.en: Pang Tong tips back a mouthful of wine.

small.zh: 『西川的酒，听说比荆州的好。』他说。
small.en: 'They say the wine in the west is better than Jingzhou's,' he says.

small.zh: 他望着灯花，不知在想什么。
small.en: He watches the lamp, thinking about something.

threat.zh: 庞统一点也不怕：『要动手就快些，我还要喝酒。』
threat.en: Pang Tong isn't the least afraid. 'If you're going to do it, be quick. I want my wine.'

threat.zh: 他把酒囊收了起来：『今夜到此为止。』
threat.en: He puts the wine skin away. 'That's enough for tonight.'

nonsense.zh: 庞统哈哈一笑：『这话比我的长相还古怪。』
nonsense.en: Pang Tong laughs. 'That's even stranger than my face.'

nonsense.zh: 『你这是在打什么哑谜？』
nonsense.en: 'What riddle is this?'

persona.zh: 庞统：道号凤雏，与诸葛亮齐名；相貌古怪，放旷不羁，好酒，嘴上刻薄，心里比谁都急着建功。称玩家“子衡”。
persona.en: Pang Tong, the Young Phoenix, as famous as Zhuge Liang; odd-looking, unconventional, fond of wine, sharp-tongued, and more eager than anyone to prove himself. Calls the player Ziheng.

warm.zh: 庞统举起酒囊：『来得正好，一个人喝没意思。』
warm.en: Pang Tong raises a wine skin. 'Just in time. Drinking alone is dull.'

cold.en: Pang Tong doesn't look up. 'Say what you came to say.'

neutral.zh: 庞统朝对面的席位努了努嘴。
neutral.en: Pang Tong jerks his chin at the seat opposite.

love.zh: 法正看了你一眼：『子衡，这种话，留着说给该说的人。』
love.en: Fa Zheng gives you a look. 'Ziheng, save that for someone it's meant for.'

love.zh: 『我记性好，』他淡淡地说，『这句我也会记着。』
love.en: 'I have a good memory,' he says coolly. 'I'll remember this one too.'

insult.zh: 法正没有生气，只是把你的话一个字一个字地重复了一遍。
insult.en: Fa Zheng doesn't get angry. He just repeats what you said, word for word.

insult.zh: 『好。』他说，『孝直记下了。』
insult.en: 'Fine,' he says. 'Xiaozhi has noted it.'

praise.zh: 『过奖。』法正嘴上客气，眼里却很受用。
praise.en: 'Too kind.' Polite words; he's pleased all the same.

praise.zh: 『这话，主公面前说一遍更好。』他笑道。
praise.en: 'Even better if you said it in front of our lord,' he says, smiling.

ask.zh: 法正反问：『你想知道的，是事，还是我怎么看这件事？』
ask.en: Fa Zheng asks back. 'Do you want the facts, or what I make of them?'

ask.zh: 『这个，』他用指头敲了敲地图，『要看曹操那边先动哪一步。』
ask.en: 'That,' he taps the map, 'depends on which piece Cao Cao moves first.'

small.zh: 法正在看地图，嗯了一声。
small.en: Fa Zheng is studying the map. He grunts.

small.zh: 『汉中的山，比成都的冷。』他说。
small.en: 'The mountains at Hanzhong are colder than Chengdu's,' he says.

small.zh: 他把一面小旗插到地图上，又拔了出来。
small.en: He sticks a little flag into the map, then pulls it out again.

threat.zh: 法正抬起眼：『在军中说这种话，你知道是什么罪？』
threat.en: Fa Zheng looks up. 'You know what the penalty is for saying that in camp?'

threat.zh: 他没有叫人，只是把你的话写在了一片竹简上。
threat.en: He calls no one. He just writes your words down on a bamboo slip.

nonsense.zh: 法正打量着你，像在算一笔账。
nonsense.en: Fa Zheng sizes you up, as if working out a sum.

nonsense.zh: 『有意思。』他说完，又低头看地图了。
nonsense.en: 'Interesting,' he says, and goes back to his map.

persona.zh: 法正：病重，这一卷开头就要走了。说话比从前软，账也不记了。称玩家“子衡”。
persona.en: Fa Zheng: gravely ill, and gone early in this volume. He speaks more softly than before and has stopped keeping accounts. Calls the player Ziheng.

warm.zh: 法正把地图推到一边：『来得正好，我正想找个人说说话。』
warm.en: Fa Zheng pushes the map aside. 'Good timing. I wanted someone to talk to.'

neutral.zh: 法正朝对面的席位点了点头。
neutral.en: Fa Zheng nods at the seat across from him.

love.zh: 黄忠哈哈大笑，胡子都抖了起来：『先生拿老夫寻开心！』
love.en: Huang Zhong roars with laughter, his beard shaking. 'You're having fun with an old man, sir!'

love.zh: 『这种话，』他摆摆手，『说给年轻人听去。』
love.en: 'Say that sort of thing,' he waves a hand, 'to the young ones.'

insult.zh: 黄忠把弓往地上一顿：『你说谁老？』
insult.en: Huang Zhong plants his bow on the ground. 'Who are you calling old?'

insult.zh: 『老夫这口刀，还没卷刃！』他瞪着你。
insult.en: 'This old blade hasn't lost its edge yet!' He glares at you.

praise.zh: 黄忠笑得合不拢嘴：『先生有眼光！』
praise.en: Huang Zhong can't stop grinning. 'You've got an eye, sir!'

praise.zh: 『这话，你去跟关将军说一遍。』他得意地说。
praise.en: 'Go say that to General Guan,' he says, pleased with himself.

ask.zh: 黄忠挠挠头：『这个……你问军师去。老夫只管砍人。』
ask.en: Huang Zhong scratches his head. 'That… ask the strategist. I just do the cutting.'

ask.zh: 『打仗的事问我，』他拍着胸口，『别的，老夫不懂。』
ask.en: 'Ask me about fighting,' he thumps his chest. 'The rest, I don't know.'

small.zh: 黄忠在磨刀，嘴里哼着长沙的小调。
small.en: Huang Zhong is sharpening his blade, humming a Changsha tune.

small.zh: 『今晚的饭，硬了些。』他说。
small.en: 'Tonight's rice was a bit hard,' he says.

small.zh: 他拉了拉弓弦，听那一声响。
small.en: He plucks his bowstring and listens to it sing.

threat.zh: 黄忠的刀已经横了过来：『你再说一遍？』
threat.en: Huang Zhong's blade is already across his knees. 'Say that again?'

threat.zh: 『老夫杀过的人，比你见过的还多。』
threat.en: 'I've killed more men than you've ever met.'

nonsense.zh: 黄忠眯起眼看你：『先生喝多了吧？』
nonsense.en: Huang Zhong squints at you. 'Had a few too many, sir?'

nonsense.zh: 『听不懂，』他老实地说，『你说慢点。』
nonsense.en: 'I don't follow,' he says honestly. 'Say it slower.'

persona.zh: 黄忠：七十五岁，最后一仗。称玩家“子衡先生”。
persona.en: Huang Zhong: seventy-five, his last battle. Calls the player Master Ziheng.

warm.zh: 黄忠拍着身边的空地：『先生坐！喝一口长沙的酒！』
warm.en: Huang Zhong slaps the ground beside him. 'Sit, sir! Have some Changsha wine!'

cold.zh: 黄忠擦着刀，只抬了抬眼皮。
cold.en: Huang Zhong keeps polishing his blade and barely lifts his eyes.

neutral.zh: 黄忠往火里添了一根柴：『坐。』
neutral.en: Huang Zhong puts another branch on the fire. 'Sit.'

e_wu.zh: 东吴那一趟，是你促成的
e_wu.en: The mission to Wu was your doing

e_praise.en: You praised Ma Su in front of everyone

e_doubt.zh: 你把先帝那句话告诉了丞相
e_doubt.en: You told the Chancellor what the late emperor said

e_release.en: You argued for letting Meng Huo go the first time

e_lushui.zh: 泸水夜渡的法子，是你问来的
e_lushui.en: You were the one who found out how to cross the Lu at night

e_cure.zh: 哑泉的解药，温芷先认出来了
e_cure.en: Wen Zhi was the first to recognise the cure for the Mute Spring

e_mercy.zh: 盘蛇谷那条出路，是你劝着留的
e_mercy.en: The way out of Coiled Snake Valley was your doing

text.zh: 先帝葬在惠陵，太子即位。曹丕趁丧起五路大兵来攻。丞相闭门不出，几天以后，四路都退了，只剩东吴一路。他说：要重新和东吴交好。
text.en: The late emperor is laid to rest; the Crown Prince takes the throne. Cao Pi seizes the moment and sends five armies at once. The Chancellor shuts his doors for days, and when he opens them, four of the five have turned back—only Wu remains. He says: we must make friends with Wu again.

text.zh: 白帝城回来以后，你和丞相，一个管外，一个管内。
text.en: Since Baidi, you and the Chancellor divide the work: he the inside, you the outside.

text.zh: 南中的雍闿、高定、朱褒反了，蛮王孟获起兵相应。丞相亲自南征，你随军。出城那天，马谡来送行。
text.en: In the south, Yong Kai, Gao Ding and Zhu Bao have rebelled, and the Man king Meng Huo has risen with them. The Chancellor marches south himself, and you go with him. On the day you leave the city, Ma Su comes to see you off.

text.zh: 五月，到了泸水边。天热得像在火上烤。河对岸，孟获又聚起了人马。
text.en: The fifth month, and you reach the Lu River. The heat is like being roasted over a fire. On the far bank, Meng Huo has gathered his men again.

text.zh: 孟获逃进了秃龙洞。往那边去的路，只有两条，一条被石头塞住了，另一条，听说有四口毒泉。
text.en: Meng Huo has fled to Bald Dragon Cave. There are only two roads there; one is blocked with rocks, and on the other, they say, are four poisoned springs.

text.zh: 孟获请来了乌戈国的兀突骨。他的兵穿藤甲：藤在油里泡半年，晒干了再泡，刀箭皆不能入，渡河不沉。
text.en: Meng Huo has called in Wutugu of Wuge. His men wear rattan armour: the rattan is soaked in oil for half a year, dried, soaked again—blades and arrows cannot get in, and it floats across rivers.

text.zh: 孟获第七次被押进了帐。
text.en: For the seventh time, Meng Huo is brought into the tent in bonds.

title.en: A Letter from an Old Friend

text.zh: 你离开蜀中已经好多年了。
text.en: It has been many years since you left Shu.

text.zh: 你在北方住了很多年。曹丕做了皇帝，又在打东吴。
text.en: You've lived in the north for many years. Cao Pi is emperor, and at war with Wu again.

text.zh: 丞相的信只有一句：『先帝走了。亮一个人，忙不过来。』
text.en: The Chancellor's letter is one line long: 'The late emperor is gone. I can't manage alone.'

label.en: Set out for Chengdu.

text.zh: 丞相在相府门口等你，鬓角白了。他说：『来了就好，先吃饭。』
text.en: The Chancellor waits at the gate of his offices, grey at the temples. 'You're here. Good. Eat first.'

label.en: Put the letter away. You won't go.

text.zh: 那年秋天，你听说丞相去了南边，打了好几仗，抓了一个人七次。
text.en: That autumn you hear the Chancellor has gone south, fought several battles, and caught one man seven times.

text.zh: 丞相说，和东吴的仇，先放下；去东吴的人，要能说话，也要不怕死。孙权在殿前支了一口油鼎，等着来使。他问你：谁去？
text.en: The Chancellor says the feud with Wu must be set aside for now; whoever goes must be able to talk and must not fear death. Sun Quan has set a cauldron of boiling oil before his hall to greet the envoy. He asks you: who goes?

text.zh: 关羽在一旁冷着脸：『和东吴交好？荆州呢？』
text.en: Guan Yu, beside him, is stony. 'Friends with Wu? And Jingzhou?'

label.zh: 举荐邓芝：他见过孙权，也不怕那口锅。
label.en: Recommend Deng Zhi: he's met Sun Quan, and he isn't afraid of that cauldron.

text.zh: 邓芝去了。他在油鼎前大笑，说孙权连一个儒生都怕。孙权撤了鼎，两家又结了盟。丞相说：『子衡兄识人。』
text.en: Deng Zhi goes. Before the cauldron he laughs aloud and says Sun Quan is afraid of a mere scholar. Sun Quan has the cauldron taken away, and the two houses are allied again. The Chancellor says, 'You know your men, Ziheng.'

label.en: Say: I'll go.

text.zh: 你站在油鼎前，热气扑在脸上。你说：西蜀有山川之险，东吴有三江之固，两家合则进可兼并天下，分则都不保。孙权看了你很久，让人撤了鼎。
text.en: You stand before the cauldron, the heat on your face. You say: Shu has its mountains, Wu its three rivers; together they could take the realm, apart neither is safe. Sun Quan looks at you a long time, and has the cauldron taken away.

text.zh: 孙权问你：『麦城那天，拉住关羽马的人，是不是你？』你说是。他笑了：『那这盟，我信得过。』
text.en: Sun Quan asks you, 'That day at Maicheng—were you the one who caught Guan Yu's bridle?' You say yes. He laughs. 'Then this alliance I can trust.'

label.en: Say: let Wu come to us first.

text.zh: 丞相摇了摇头，还是派了邓芝。
text.en: The Chancellor shakes his head and sends Deng Zhi all the same.

text.zh: 东吴回访的使者张温在宴席上，仗着酒意，考问蜀中的学士。学士秦宓喝醉了，坐在你旁边，捅了捅你：『先生，他问天有没有头，你说我答，还是你答？』
text.en: At the banquet, Zhang Wen, Wu's return envoy, grows bold with wine and starts quizzing the scholars of Shu. Qin Mi, drunk, sits beside you and nudges you. 'Sir, he's asking whether Heaven has a head. Shall I answer, or will you?'

label.en: Let Qin Mi answer.

text.zh: 秦宓站起来，从《诗经》答到《易经》，天有头、有耳、有足、有姓——姓刘。张温哑口无言，宴席上笑声不断。
text.en: Qin Mi stands and answers from the Songs to the Changes: Heaven has a head, ears, feet, and a surname—Liu. Zhang Wen is struck dumb, and the banquet roars with laughter.

label.zh: 你来答，留张温一点面子。
label.en: Answer yourself, and leave Zhang Wen some dignity.

text.zh: 你答得客气，张温也接得客气。散席时他对你拱手：『蜀中有人。』
text.en: You answer courteously, and Zhang Wen takes it courteously. As the banquet breaks up, he bows to you. 'Shu has men.'

text.zh: 回成都以后，你和温芷成了亲。院子里种了药，也种了一棵梅。她问你：要是打仗，你还走不走？
text.en: Back in Chengdu, you and Wen Zhi married. The yard has herbs in it now, and a plum tree. She asks you: if there's war again, will you go?

label.en: Say: I'll go. And you'll come too.

text.zh: 她笑了：『我本来就要去。』
text.en: She laughs. 'I was going anyway.'

label.zh: 说：这回你留下，替我守着院子。
label.en: Say: this time you stay and keep the house for me.

text.zh: 她没说话，第二天，把药箱放在了门口。
text.en: She says nothing. The next day her medicine chest is by the door.

text.zh: 温芷的医馆收了几个学徒。她听说丞相要南征，来问你：南边的病，她一样都没见过，该带什么药？
text.en: Wen Zhi's clinic has taken on a few apprentices. She's heard the Chancellor is going south and asks you: she's never seen any of the southern sicknesses—what medicines should she bring?

label.zh: 陪她去找从南中来的商人，一样一样地问。
label.en: Go with her to find merchants from the south and ask about every one.

text.zh: 你们问了十几天，记了满满一本。她说，这本子比药还重要。
text.en: You spend more than ten days asking and fill a whole notebook. She says the notebook matters more than the medicine.

label.en: Say: come along and we'll see when we get there.

text.zh: 她点点头，开始收拾药箱。
text.en: She nods and starts packing her chest.

text.zh: 关羽在先帝的灵前坐了一整夜。天亮时他对你说：『大哥把阿斗托给了丞相和你。我呢，就替他守着成都。』
text.en: Guan Yu sat all night before the late emperor's tablet. At dawn he tells you, 'My brother left A Dou to the Chancellor and you. As for me, I'll keep Chengdu for him.'

text.zh: 张飞喝了三天酒，第四天把酒坛都砸了：『大哥不在了，俺得替他看着阿斗。』
text.en: Zhang Fei drinks for three days. On the fourth he smashes every jar. 'Elder brother's gone. I've got to watch over A Dou for him.'

label.en: Sit with him a while.

text.zh: 你们谁都没说话。
text.en: Neither of you says anything.

label.en: Ask him to march south with the Chancellor.

text.zh: 他摇摇头：『南边的事，交给你们。成都得有人。』
text.en: He shakes his head. 'The south is yours. Chengdu needs someone.'

text.zh: 马谡送了几十里，丞相问他有什么话。马谡说：南蛮仗着地远山险，今天打服了，明天又反。『攻心为上，攻城为下；心战为上，兵战为下。愿丞相但服其心足矣。』丞相叹道：『幼常足知吾肺腑也！』
text.en: Ma Su rides along for dozens of li, and the Chancellor asks if he has anything to say. Ma Su says the southerners trust in distance and mountains; beat them today and they'll rise again tomorrow. Attacking hearts is best, attacking cities worst; war on the mind is best, war with troops worst. Let the Chancellor win their hearts and that will be enough. The Chancellor sighs that Youchang knows his very heart.

text.zh: 你想起白帝城里，先帝压低了声音说的那句话。
text.en: You remember what the late emperor said in Baidi, his voice very low.

label.zh: 当众说：幼常这番话，说得好。
label.en: Say in front of everyone: Youchang has put it well.

text.zh: 马谡朝你深深一揖。丞相很高兴，回头又看了马谡一眼。
text.en: Ma Su bows deeply to you. The Chancellor is pleased, and looks back at Ma Su once more.

label.zh: 等马谡走了，私下对丞相说：先帝说过，此人言过其实，不可大用。
label.en: When Ma Su has gone, tell the Chancellor privately: the late emperor said this man's words outrun his worth, and he must not be given great charge.

text.zh: 丞相沉默了很久：『亮知道。』他又说：『可他今天这句话，是对的。』
text.en: The Chancellor is silent a long time. 'I know.' Then he adds, 'But what he said today was right.'

label.zh: 说：话是好话，能不能做到，要看到了南边。
label.en: Say: fine words; whether they can be done, we'll see in the south.

text.zh: 马谡笑了笑，没说什么。
text.en: Ma Su smiles and says nothing.

quote.zh: 攻心为上，攻城为下；心战为上，兵战为下。……幼常足知吾肺腑也！
quote.en: Attacking hearts is best, attacking cities worst; war on the mind is best, war with troops worst. … Youchang knows my very heart!

text.zh: 孟获被王平、关索诱进山谷，捆了来。丞相问：『吾今擒汝，汝心服否？』孟获说：山路狭窄，误中你的计，怎么服？『汝放我回去，再整军马，共决雌雄；若能再擒吾，吾方服也。』丞相转头看你。
text.en: Lured into a valley, Meng Huo is taken and brought in bound. The Chancellor asks whether, now he's been caught, his heart submits. Meng Huo says he fell into a trick on a narrow mountain road—why should he submit? Let him go, and he'll gather his men and fight it out; catch him again and he'll submit. The Chancellor turns to you.

label.zh: 说：放。马谡说得对，要服的是心。
label.en: Say: let him go. Ma Su is right—it's the heart that has to submit.

text.zh: 丞相笑了，让人给孟获松绑，赐酒，送他出营。孟获走的时候，一直回头看。
text.en: The Chancellor smiles, has Meng Huo untied, gives him wine, and sees him out of the camp. Meng Huo keeps looking back as he goes.

label.zh: 说：放他，但把他手下的几个头人留下，打听清楚南中的路。
label.en: Say: let him go, but keep a few of his chieftains and learn the southern roads from them.

text.zh: 丞相想了想，留了两个人。后来这两个人领着蜀兵，走了好几条没人知道的小路。
text.en: The Chancellor considers, and keeps two. Later those two lead the Shu army down several paths no one else knew.

label.zh: 说：杀了。放虎归山，后患无穷。
label.en: Say: kill him. Let a tiger back into the hills and you'll never be rid of it.

text.zh: 丞相摇头：『杀一个孟获，南中还有十个孟获。』他还是放了。
text.en: The Chancellor shakes his head. 'Kill one Meng Huo and the south has ten more.' He lets him go all the same.

quote.zh: 吾今擒汝，汝心服否？……汝放我回去，再整军马，共决雌雄；若能再擒吾，吾方服也。
quote.en: "I have taken you now—does your heart submit?" … "Let me go back, gather my army again, and we'll settle it; if you can take me again, then I'll submit."

text.zh: 马谡不在这里。可你说的那句“说得好”，丞相还记着。
text.en: Ma Su isn't here. But the Chancellor still remembers you saying 'well put.'

q.zh: 孟获被押走以后，丞相问你：『子衡兄，你说，一个人要被抓几次，心才会服？』
q.en: When Meng Huo has been taken away, the Chancellor asks, 'Ziheng, how many times must a man be caught before his heart submits?'

text.zh: 丞相愣了一下，看了你很久：『为什么是七？』你没有回答。
text.en: The Chancellor starts, and looks at you a long time. 'Why seven?' You don't answer.

means.en: says no number will do it

text.zh: 丞相摇头：『那南中就永远不会太平了。』
text.en: The Chancellor shakes his head. 'Then the south will never be at peace.'

answers.match: 不会服|永远不|几次都不|never|no number|won't

means.zh: 说要抓到他自己不想走
means.en: says until he no longer wants to leave

text.zh: 丞相笑了：『那就抓到他不想走为止。』
text.en: The Chancellor smiles. 'Then we catch him until he doesn't want to go.'

answers.match: 不想走|自己|心服|几次都|直到|until|doesn't want|his own|heart

text.zh: 丞相没有追问。
text.en: The Chancellor doesn't press.

text.zh: 南征路上的一个晚上，丞相把地图收起来，对你说：『子衡兄，今晚不看图了。陪亮坐坐。』
text.en: One night on the march south, the Chancellor rolls up his map. 'No maps tonight, Ziheng. Sit with me a while.'

text.zh: 他看着你，像是有话要说，又咽了回去。
text.en: He looks at you as if he has something to say, and swallows it.

label.en: Say goodnight and go.

text.zh: 你走的时候，丞相说：『白帝城那天，先帝把你的手和亮的手放在一起。亮记着。』
text.en: As you leave, the Chancellor says, 'That day at Baidi, the late emperor laid your hand with mine. I remember.'

text.zh: 你走的时候，丞相说：『子衡兄，以后夜里，常来坐坐。』
text.en: As you leave, the Chancellor says, 'Come and sit with me of an evening, Ziheng. Often.'

label.zh: 问他：先帝那句“君可自取”，你怎么想？
label.en: Ask him: what do you make of the late emperor's 'you may take it yourself'?

text.zh: 丞相很久没说话。最后他说：『那句话，是先帝给亮的一把刀。亮这辈子，只能把刀柄朝着自己。』
text.en: The Chancellor says nothing for a long time. At last: 'Those words were a knife the late emperor handed me. All my life I'll have to hold it by the blade.'

label.en: Ask him: and after the south?

text.zh: 丞相把地图又摊开了一角，指着北边：『南边是为了北边。』他又把图卷上了，『今晚不说这个。』
text.en: The Chancellor unrolls a corner of the map again and points north. 'The south is for the sake of the north.' He rolls it up again. 'Not tonight.'

label.zh: 劝他：事情不必都自己管。
label.en: Tell him: you don't have to see to everything yourself.

text.zh: 丞相笑了：『子衡兄，你是第三个这么劝亮的人。』前两个是谁，他没说。
text.en: The Chancellor smiles. 'You're the third man to tell me that, Ziheng.' He doesn't say who the first two were.

text.zh: 第一批过河的兵见水浅，没上筏子，光着身子蹚过去，走到河中间一个个倒下，抬到岸边，口鼻出血而死。丞相大惊。
text.en: The first men across see the water is shallow, skip the rafts and wade over naked; halfway across they fall one after another, and when they're dragged to the bank, they die bleeding from mouth and nose. The Chancellor is aghast.

text.zh: 河边有几个当地人，远远地看着，不说话。
text.en: A few local people stand by the river at a distance, watching, saying nothing.

label.zh: 走过去，给那几个当地人递上干粮，问他们怎么渡。
label.en: Walk over, offer the locals some rations, and ask how to cross.

text.zh: 一个老人说：『若要渡时，须待夜静水冷，毒气不起，饱食渡之，方可无事。』那天夜里，大军吃饱了，一个不少地过了河。丞相对你说：『攻心，原来是这样攻的。』
text.en: An old man tells you: to cross, wait for the quiet of night when the water is cold and the poison doesn't rise, eat well, then cross, and no harm will come. That night the army eats its fill and crosses without losing a man. The Chancellor says to you, 'So that's how you win hearts.'

label.en: Go to Wen Zhi: what poison is this?

text.zh: 温芷看了尸体，又试了水：『是热毒，太阳一晒就起来。』她说夜里水凉了也许能过。丞相照她说的试了，夜里果然过去了，只是试的那一次，又倒了几个人。
text.en: Wen Zhi examines the dead and tests the water. 'It's a heat poison—the sun brings it up.' She thinks it might be crossed at night when the water cools. The Chancellor tries it her way, and at night it works—only, in the trial, a few more men fell.

label.zh: 劝丞相先停下，等弄明白了再说。
label.en: Urge the Chancellor to stop until it's understood.

text.zh: 丞相等了三天，派人四处打听，才问到夜渡的法子。这三天里，又有几拨兵偷偷下河取水。
text.en: The Chancellor waits three days and sends men everywhere to ask before he learns the trick of crossing at night. In those three days, several more parties sneak down to the river for water.

quote.zh: 若要渡时，须待夜静水冷，毒气不起，饱食渡之，方可无事。
quote.en: If you must cross, wait for the quiet of night when the water is cold and the poison does not rise; eat your fill and cross, and no harm will come.

text.zh: 那几个当地人里，有一个认得你：『你就是劝丞相放孟大王的人？』
text.en: One of the locals knows you. 'You're the one who told the Chancellor to let King Meng go?'

text.zh: 孟获的弟弟孟优带着一百多个人，抬着金珠宝贝来投降，说哥哥知道错了。丞相收下了礼物，留他们在营里喝酒。散席后，他问你：『子衡兄，怎么看？』
text.en: Meng Huo's brother Meng You comes with a hundred-odd men bearing gold and pearls to surrender: his brother knows he was wrong, he says. The Chancellor accepts the gifts and keeps them in camp to drink. After the feast he asks you, 'Ziheng, what do you think?'

label.zh: 说：一百多个人，都是精壮的。这是里应外合。
label.en: Say: a hundred-odd men, every one of them strong. This is to open the gates from inside.

text.zh: 丞相笑了：『和亮想的一样。』那天夜里，孟获来劫寨，进来的是空营，酒里下了药的，是孟优那一百多人。丞相对孟获说：『汝先令汝弟以礼诈降，如何瞒得我过！今番又被我擒，汝可服否？』
text.en: The Chancellor smiles. 'Just what I thought.' That night Meng Huo comes to raid the camp and finds it empty; it's Meng You's hundred men whose wine was drugged. The Chancellor says to Meng Huo: you had your brother feign surrender with gifts—how did you think that would fool me? Caught again—do you submit now?

label.zh: 说：也许是真的。先当真的待。
label.en: Say: it may be real. Treat it as real for now.

text.zh: 丞相看了你一眼，没说话。那天夜里，他还是布好了伏兵。孟获又被擒了。孟优被押走的时候，对你说：『只有你信过我们。』
text.en: The Chancellor glances at you and says nothing. That night he lays his ambush all the same. Meng Huo is caught again. As Meng You is led away he says to you, 'Only you believed us.'

quote.zh: 汝先令汝弟以礼诈降，如何瞒得我过！今番又被我擒，汝可服否？
quote.en: You first had your brother feign surrender with gifts—how could that deceive me? Now you are taken again—do you submit?

text.zh: 营里一半的人发了热。温芷三天三夜没睡，眼睛熬得通红。她说药不够了。
text.en: Half the camp is down with fever. Wen Zhi hasn't slept in three days and nights; her eyes are red raw. She says the medicine's running out.

label.zh: 带人上山，照她说的样子采草药。
label.en: Take men up the hills and gather herbs the way she describes.

text.zh: 你们采回来三筐，有一筐是对的。温芷说：『够了。』
text.en: You bring back three baskets, and one of them is right. Wen Zhi says, 'That's enough.'

label.zh: 把她按到床上：剩下的你来守。
label.en: Make her lie down: you'll take the watch.

text.zh: 她睡了两个时辰，醒来看见你还守在病人中间，没说话，把一碗药递给你：『你也喝。』
text.en: She sleeps for four hours, wakes to find you still among the sick, says nothing, and hands you a bowl. 'You drink some too.'

text.zh: 王平带的前军走了一天，渴极了，找到一口泉，人马都喝了。回到大寨的时候，皆不能言，但指口而已。丞相大惊。
text.en: Wang Ping's vanguard marches all day, parched, finds a spring, and men and horses all drink. When they get back to the main camp, none of them can speak; they can only point at their mouths. The Chancellor is aghast.

text.zh: 温芷翻着那几页抄来的医书，手停在了一页上。
text.en: Wen Zhi is leafing through the pages she copied, and her hand stops on one.

label.en: Look at Wen Zhi. 'You've found something?'

text.zh: 她点头：『华佗先生写过，南边有一种泉，喝了失声，要用一种叫薤叶芸香的草，还要喝另一口泉的水。』丞相派人四处找，第二天就在山里找到了一个隐者。那人说：『某乃孟获之兄孟节是也。』他指了安乐泉，又让众人口含薤叶。前军一个没死。
text.en: She nods. 'Master Hua wrote of it: a spring in the south that takes away the voice; the cure is an herb called xie-leaf rue, and water from another spring.' The Chancellor sends men searching, and the next day they find a hermit in the hills who names himself Meng Jie, Meng Huo's elder brother. He shows them the Spring of Peace and has everyone hold a xie leaf in their mouths. Not a man of the vanguard dies.

label.zh: 跟丞相一起进山，找懂这泉的人。
label.en: Go into the hills with the Chancellor to find someone who knows the spring.

text.zh: 你们在一座古庙里问到了路，又在山里找到了一个隐者。那人说：『某乃孟获之兄孟节是也。』他指了安乐泉，又让众人口含薤叶。前军救回来一大半。
text.en: In an old shrine you learn the way, and deep in the hills you find a hermit who names himself Meng Jie, Meng Huo's elder brother. He shows you the Spring of Peace and has everyone hold a xie leaf in their mouths. More than half the vanguard is saved.

label.zh: 先传令全军：没查过的水，一口也不许喝。
label.en: First send word to the whole army: not a mouthful of unchecked water.

text.zh: 后面的几营都停了下来，渴了一天一夜。有人骂你。第二天，他们知道了前军的事，不骂了。
text.en: The rear camps halt and go thirsty a whole day and night. Some men curse you. The next day they hear what happened to the vanguard, and stop.

quote.zh: 比及到大寨之时，皆不能言，但指口而已。……某乃孟获之兄孟节是也。
quote.en: By the time they reached the main camp, none of them could speak; they could only point at their mouths. … "I am Meng Jie, Meng Huo's elder brother."

text.zh: 丞相说：『泸水那回是你问的路。这回，也劳你去问。』
text.en: The Chancellor says, 'At the Lu it was you who asked the way. This time too, I'll trouble you to ask.'

text.zh: 赵云在帐外擦枪。枪杆上的漆磨掉了一大半。他看见你，往旁边挪了挪：『先生坐。』
text.en: Zhao Yun is polishing his spear outside his tent. Most of the lacquer on the shaft has worn away. He sees you and shifts aside. 'Sit, Master.'

label.en: Say goodnight and go.

text.zh: 你走的时候，赵云说：『先生，往后的仗，我们这些老的，打一仗少一仗了。』
text.en: As you leave, Zhao Yun says, 'Master, from here on, for us old ones, every battle is one fewer.'

label.zh: 问他：这杆枪，跟了你多少年？
label.en: Ask him: how many years has this spear been with you?

text.zh: 赵云想了想：『从公孙瓒那里出来，就是它。』他摸着枪杆，『长坂坡那天，它比我还累。』
text.en: Zhao Yun thinks. 'Since I left Gongsun Zan. Always this one.' He runs his hand along the shaft. 'That day at Changban it was more tired than I was.'

label.zh: 问他：丞相要北伐，你还去吗？
label.en: Ask him: when the Chancellor goes north, will you go?

text.zh: 赵云笑了：『丞相不让我去，我也去。』
text.en: Zhao Yun smiles. 'Even if the Chancellor won't let me, I'll go.'

label.en: Speak of the late emperor.

text.zh: 赵云低下头，过了很久才说：『先帝信我，一辈子。』
text.en: Zhao Yun lowers his head, and after a long while says, 'The late emperor trusted me. All his life.'

text.zh: 藤甲兵刀箭不入，蜀兵连败了几阵。丞相看了一天地形，回来说：前面有个山谷，叫盘蛇谷，两边是光秃秃的石壁，只有一条路。他让人运去十辆黑油柜车，在谷里埋下火药。他把布置说给你听，问你：『子衡兄，你看呢？』
text.en: Blades and arrows can't touch the rattan troops, and the Shu army loses several engagements. The Chancellor studies the ground all day, then comes back: ahead is a valley called Coiled Snake, bare rock on both sides and a single road. He has ten carts of black oil sent in and powder buried in the valley. He lays out the plan for you and asks, 'What do you think, Ziheng?'

label.zh: 说：火可以放。可谷口留一条出路，让愿意扔下藤甲的人走出来。
label.en: Say: set the fire. But leave a way out at the mouth of the valley, for anyone who throws off his armour.

text.zh: 丞相想了很久，点了头。那一夜，盘蛇谷烧了起来。谷口那条路上，扔下藤甲跑出来的人，有好几千。丞相站在山上，还是哭了：『吾虽有功于社稷，必损寿矣！』
text.en: The Chancellor thinks a long time, then nods. That night Coiled Snake Valley burns. Along the road at its mouth, several thousand men come running out, their armour flung away. Standing on the hill, the Chancellor weeps all the same: though he has served the realm, this will cost him years of his life.

label.zh: 说：油车不如分两处，前后一起点，一个也跑不出去。
label.en: Say: split the oil carts in two places, light both ends at once, and not one will escape.

text.zh: 丞相看了你一眼，照做了。那一夜，盘蛇谷里三万藤甲兵，没有一个出来。丞相在山上垂泪：『吾虽有功于社稷，必损寿矣！』他没有看你。
text.en: The Chancellor glances at you and does it. That night not one of the thirty thousand rattan soldiers comes out of Coiled Snake Valley. On the hill the Chancellor weeps that though he has served the realm, this will cost him years. He doesn't look at you.

label.en: You can't say anything.

text.zh: 那一夜，盘蛇谷烧了起来。丞相在山上垂泪：『吾虽有功于社稷，必损寿矣！』你站在他身后，闻到了风里的味道。
text.en: That night Coiled Snake Valley burns. On the hill the Chancellor weeps that though he has served the realm, this will cost him years. You stand behind him and smell what the wind carries.

quote.zh: 吾虽有功于社稷，必损寿矣！
quote.en: Though I have done service to the realm, this will surely shorten my life!

text.zh: 你想起第一次放孟获的那天。攻心——心也会被火烧。
text.en: You think of the day you let Meng Huo go the first time. Win their hearts—hearts burn too.

q.zh: 火灭以后，丞相一个人坐在山石上，问你：『子衡兄，亮今天做的事，会不会遭报应？』
q.en: When the fire is out, the Chancellor sits alone on a rock and asks you, 'Ziheng, will what I did today come back on me?'

means.en: says half of it is on you

text.zh: 丞相看了你一眼，眼眶红了：『子衡兄……』他没说下去。
text.en: The Chancellor looks at you, eyes reddening. 'Ziheng…' He doesn't go on.

answers.match: 一半|我也|算我|我们|half|me too|on me|we both

text.zh: 丞相点头：『亮会记着。』他把那天的日子，写在了扇子上。
text.en: The Chancellor nods. 'I'll remember.' He writes the day's date on his fan.

means.zh: 说不会，这是为了南中太平
means.en: says no—it was for the south's peace

text.zh: 丞相没有说话，过了很久才说：『但愿。』
text.en: The Chancellor says nothing for a long time, then: 'Let's hope so.'

answers.match: 不会|为了|太平|不得已|没办法|no|for peace|had to|no choice

text.zh: 丞相站起来，拍了拍衣上的灰：『走吧。』
text.en: The Chancellor stands and brushes off his robe. 'Let's go.'

text.zh: 火灭了以后，温芷一个人去了谷口。她在那里给烧伤的南人包扎，有人用你听不懂的话骂她，她也不停手。
text.en: When the fire is out, Wen Zhi goes alone to the mouth of the valley. She's binding the burns of southerners there; some of them curse her in words you can't understand, and she doesn't stop.

label.en: Go and help her.

text.zh: 你们忙到天亮。一个被你们救下的人，临走时把一串骨珠塞进了温芷手里。
text.en: You work until dawn. One of the men you saved presses a string of bone beads into Wen Zhi's hand as he leaves.

label.en: Send a few soldiers to stand guard over her.

text.zh: 兵到了，她让他们也来帮忙抬人。
text.en: The soldiers arrive, and she puts them to work carrying the wounded.

text.zh: 丞相又让人给孟获松绑：『你再回去，再来。』孟获不走了。他跪在帐前，垂泪说：『七擒七纵，自古未尝有也。』又说：『丞相天威，南人不复反矣！』
text.en: Once more the Chancellor has Meng Huo untied: go back, and come again. Meng Huo won't go. He kneels before the tent and weeps: seven times caught, seven times freed—such a thing has never been. And then: the Chancellor's majesty is like Heaven's; the people of the south will never rebel again.

text.zh: 费祎劝丞相在南中设官留兵。丞相说：『留外人则当留兵，兵无所食，一不易也……』他又转头问你。
text.en: Fei Yi urges the Chancellor to set up officials and leave a garrison in the south. The Chancellor says that to leave outsiders means leaving soldiers, and soldiers with nothing to eat—that's the first difficulty… He turns to ask you.

label.zh: 说：不留官，不留兵，南中交给孟获自己管。
label.en: Say: no officials, no garrison. Let Meng Huo govern the south himself.

text.zh: 丞相点头。南人听说了，家家户户给丞相立了生祠。
text.en: The Chancellor nods. When the southerners hear, every household sets up a shrine to him.

label.zh: 说：兵不留，可留几个懂医、懂农的人。
label.en: Say: leave no soldiers—but leave a few people who know medicine and farming.

text.zh: 丞相想了想：『这倒不算外人。』后来南中的几个寨子里，有了药铺和水车。
text.en: The Chancellor considers. 'Those don't count as outsiders.' Later, in several southern villages, there are herb shops and waterwheels.

label.zh: 说：把孟获的儿子带回成都，以防万一。
label.en: Say: take Meng Huo's son back to Chengdu, just in case.

text.zh: 丞相摇头：『攻心，心已经攻下来了，还要人质做什么？』
text.en: The Chancellor shakes his head. 'Win the heart—and the heart is won. What do we need a hostage for?'

quote.zh: 丞相天威，南人不复反矣！……留外人则当留兵，兵无所食，一不易也。
quote.en: "The Chancellor's majesty is like Heaven's; the people of the south will never rebel again!" … "To leave outsiders means to leave soldiers, and soldiers with nothing to eat—that is the first difficulty."

text.zh: 孟获说：『盘蛇谷口那条路，我们的人都知道是谁劝着留的。』
text.en: Meng Huo says, 'The road out of Coiled Snake Valley—all our people know who argued for it.'

text.zh: 孟获说：『我哥哥说，你们营里有个女大夫，比他还认得草。』
text.en: Meng Huo says, 'My brother says there's a woman physician in your camp who knows herbs better than he does.'

text.zh: 班师路上，丞相忽然说：『幼常的那句攻心，是对的。先帝的那句话，亮也记着。』
text.en: On the march home the Chancellor suddenly says, 'Youchang was right about winning hearts. And I remember the late emperor's words too.'

text.zh: 东吴派人来贺。来的人说，是因为蜀中有人去过东吴。
text.en: Wu sends envoys to offer congratulations. They say it's because someone from Shu came to Wu.

q.zh: 班师前一夜，丞相问你：『子衡兄，七擒七纵，花了大半年，死了那么多人。你说，值不值？』
q.en: The night before the march home the Chancellor asks, 'Ziheng, seven captures, seven releases, most of a year, so many dead. Was it worth it?'

means.zh: 说值不值，要看以后对南人怎么样
means.en: says it depends how the south is treated from now on

text.zh: 丞相想了很久：『你说得对。』他让人把南中的赋税减了一半。
text.en: The Chancellor thinks a long time. 'You're right.' He has the south's taxes cut by half.

answers.match: 以后|怎么待|对南人|赋税|看|depends|from now|treat|tax

means.zh: 说值，南边以后不会再反
means.en: says yes—the south won't rise again

text.zh: 丞相点头：『南边稳了，北边才能去。』
text.en: The Chancellor nods. 'With the south steady, the north is possible.'

answers.match: 值|不会再反|稳|北伐|worth|won't rise|steady|north

text.zh: 丞相没有反驳，只是说：『那就让它变得值。』
text.en: The Chancellor doesn't argue. 'Then let's make it worth it.'

text.zh: 丞相笑了笑，没有再问。
text.en: The Chancellor smiles and doesn't ask again.

text.zh: 大军回到泸水边，起了大风，过不了河。当地人说，要用人头祭河。丞相不肯，让人用面裹了肉，捏成人头的样子，祭了泸水。风停了。
text.en: The army reaches the Lu again, and a great wind rises; it can't cross. The locals say the river must be offered human heads. The Chancellor refuses; he has meat wrapped in dough and shaped like heads, and offers those to the Lu. The wind dies down.

text.zh: 回到成都的那天，关羽在城门口等着，一句话没说，拍了拍你的肩。
text.en: The day you're back in Chengdu, Guan Yu is waiting at the gate. He says nothing; he claps your shoulder.

text.zh: 回到成都的那天，张飞在城门口大喊：『先生回来了！』
text.en: The day you're back in Chengdu, Zhang Fei is at the gate bellowing, 'The Master's back!'

label.zh: 问丞相：下一步，是北边了吧？
label.en: Ask the Chancellor: next is the north, isn't it?

text.zh: 丞相看着你，没有回答。那天夜里，相府的灯亮到天明。
text.en: The Chancellor looks at you and doesn't answer. That night the lamps in his offices burn until dawn.

label.en: Say: Chancellor, rest for one winter first.

text.zh: 丞相笑了：『好，歇一个冬天。』你知道他不会。
text.en: The Chancellor smiles. 'All right. One winter.' You know he won't.

text.zh: 丞相已经很久没有问过你了。赵云私下说：『先生，丞相心里有事。』
text.en: It's been a long time since the Chancellor asked your opinion. Zhao Yun says privately, 'Master, something's on the Chancellor's mind.'

label.en: Go to the Chancellor and talk it through.

text.zh: 你们谈了一夜。天亮时，丞相说：『是亮想多了。』
text.en: You talk all night. At dawn the Chancellor says, 'I've been overthinking.'

hint.zh: 需要赵云的信任在「可托」以上，才有人替你说一句话
hint.en: Needs Zhao Yun's trust at Reliable or above for someone to put in a word

label.en: Wait. Do the work in front of you.

text.zh: 你的位子挪到了后排。
text.en: Your seat moves to the back row.

label.en: Take your leave.

text.zh: 丞相没有留你。
text.en: The Chancellor doesn't ask you to stay.

text.zh: 南人都在传：丞相身边有个人，比丞相还早知道山里有什么。连丞相也来问你：『子衡兄，你是从哪里知道的？』
text.en: All the southerners are saying the Chancellor has a man who knows what's in the hills before the Chancellor does. Even the Chancellor comes to ask: 'Ziheng, where do you learn these things?'

label.en: Hold your tongue from now on.

text.zh: 人们慢慢忘了。
text.en: People slowly forget.

label.en: Leave, so the Chancellor isn't tainted by you.

text.zh: 你在一个雨夜出了营。
text.en: You leave the camp one rainy night.

text.zh: 你说过的那些话，有人抄了下来，送到了丞相案头。
text.en: Someone has copied down things you've said and put them on the Chancellor's desk.

label.en: Own it: you spoke out of turn.

text.zh: 丞相没有罚你：『子衡兄，管住嘴。』
text.en: The Chancellor doesn't punish you. 'Ziheng—mind your tongue.'

label.en: Argue: every word was true.

text.zh: 『有些真话，要挑时候说。』
text.en: 'Some truths need the right moment.'

text.zh: 你没有回蜀中。南中的事，是从集市上听来的。
text.en: You never went back to Shu. You heard about the south in the market.

text.zh: 你在一个雨夜出了营。南人说，丞相身边的那个先生，回山里去了。
text.en: You left the camp one rainy night. The southerners say the Chancellor's Master went back into the hills.

text.zh: 你离开了。丞相回成都那天，你在城外的人群里。
text.en: You left. The day the Chancellor came back to Chengdu, you were in the crowd outside the walls.

text.zh: 你随丞相南征，七擒七纵，回到了成都。
text.en: You marched south with the Chancellor, through seven captures and seven releases, and came home to Chengdu.

text.zh: 泸水夜渡，一个人都没少。那几个当地人后来给大军带了一路的路。
text.en: The night crossing of the Lu cost not a single man. Those locals guided the army the whole way after.

text.zh: 哑泉边，温芷翻出了华佗的那一页。前军一个没死。
text.en: At the Mute Spring, Wen Zhi found Hua Tuo's page. Not a man of the vanguard died.

text.zh: 盘蛇谷口留了一条路。走出来的几千人，后来都回了家。
text.en: A road was left open at the mouth of Coiled Snake Valley. The several thousand who walked out all went home in the end.

text.zh: 盘蛇谷两头的火，是你布置的。丞相后来再也没让你管过火攻。
text.en: The fires at both ends of Coiled Snake Valley were your arrangement. The Chancellor never put you in charge of fire again.

text.zh: 南中的几个寨子里，有了药铺和水车。
text.en: In several southern villages there are herb shops and waterwheels now.

text.zh: 先帝说马谡言过其实。你把这句话告诉了丞相。丞相说，他记着。
text.en: The late emperor said Ma Su's words outran his worth. You told the Chancellor. He said he remembered.

text.zh: 马谡记得，攻心那句话，是你第一个说好的。
text.en: Ma Su remembers that you were the first to praise his 'win their hearts.'

text.zh: 马谡的那句攻心，丞相写在了自己的书里。
text.en: The Chancellor wrote Ma Su's 'win their hearts' into his own book.

text.zh: 温芷跟着你去了南中。回来的时候，她的药箱里多了一串骨珠。
text.en: Wen Zhi went south with you. When she came home, there was a string of bone beads in her medicine chest.

text.zh: 温芷在南中救了很多人，有蜀人，也有南人。
text.en: Wen Zhi saved many lives in the south, Shu men and southerners both.

text.zh: 你很久没有温芷的消息了。
text.en: You haven't heard from Wen Zhi in a long time.

text.zh: 南人说，丞相身边有个人，山里的事他都知道。
text.en: The southerners say the Chancellor has a man who knows everything in the hills.

text.zh: 南人记得你的名字。
text.en: The southerners remember your name.

text.zh: 人说子衡多智，也说子衡心深。
text.en: People say Ziheng is clever, and that his mind runs deep.

text.zh: 史书里没有你的传，只有几处『或曰』。
text.en: The histories give you no biography—just a few lines beginning 'some say.'

text.zh: 说书人讲到南中，有好几处讲不顺——那几处，都是你。
text.en: When storytellers reach the south, several places never quite fit. Those places are you.

text.zh: 建兴三年秋，丞相平定南中，班师回成都。南人不复反。
text.en: In the autumn of Jianxing 3 the Chancellor pacified the south and marched home to Chengdu. The south never rose again.

term.en: the Memorial on Going to War

garden.zh: 水墨淡彩，宽幅。许都后园，青梅枝从左上探入，远处城墙，右侧小亭中二人对坐煮酒，雷雨将至。图层：雷雨（闪电、雨丝）。
garden.en: Chinese ink wash with light color, wide banner. A walled garden in Xuchang: green-plum branches from the upper left, distant city wall, two men seated drinking in a small pavilion on the right, storm gathering. Layer: storm (lightning, rain).

lamp.zh: 夜，窗格内一灯如豆，一人跪坐读书，窗外竹影。图层：案上一道红色血诏。
lamp.en: Night. Through a lattice window a single lamp, a seated man reading, bamboo shadows outside. Layer: a red silk edict on the desk.

herbs.zh: 药圃，圆形月洞门，竹匾晒药，一名医女。图层：同行男子；春日落花；粉色花瓣（恋爱时刻）。
herbs.en: Herb garden with a round moon gate, bamboo drying trays, a woman physician. Layers: a man beside her; spring blossoms; pink petals (romance moment).

road.zh: 平原大路，行军队列与红旗，远处许都城墙。图层：远处尘土中的追骑。
road.en: A plain with a marching column and red banners, Xuchang's walls in the distance. Layer: pursuing riders in a dust cloud.

letter.zh: 夜，烛光书案，信笺、毛笔、砚台。图层：药包；朱印；窗外江面火光。
letter.en: Night desk by candlelight: letter, brush, inkstone. Layers: medicine packet; red seal; river glow through a window.

hill.zh: 土山被围，山顶一将与两位女眷，山下敌营红旗，一骑来劝降。图层：一骑从山后小路突围。
hill.en: A surrounded earthen hill: a general and two ladies on top, enemy tents with red flags below, a lone rider approaching to parley. Layer: a rider escaping down the back path.

hall.zh: 厅堂内景，梁柱，门外天光。图层：梁上悬印、贴封条的箱笼；一匹赤红骏马。
hall.en: Hall interior, beams and pillars, daylight through the door. Layers: an official seal hanging from a beam and sealed chests; a red warhorse.

camp.zh: 北方营寨，群山，蓝红旗帜林立。
camp.en: A northern army camp among mountains, forests of blue and red banners.

mirror.zh: 竹林溪畔，隐士抚琴，二客远立。
mirror.en: Bamboo grove by a stream, a recluse playing the zither, two visitors standing at a distance.

snow.zh: 雪中茅庐，篱笆，门外数人立雪等候。图层：第四人（徐庶）。
snow.en: A thatched cottage in snow with a fence, several men waiting outside. Layer: a fourth man (Xu Shu).

bridge.zh: 长坂桥，一将横矛立马桥上，桥东树林，百姓奔逃。图层：林中尘土（疑兵）；白袍骑将救人。
bridge.en: Changban bridge: a general with a spear on horseback on the bridge, woods to the east, fleeing civilians. Layers: dust in the woods (feint); a white-robed rider rescuing.

slope.zh: 山坡上曹操与旌旗，坡下枪阵，一白袍将怀抱婴儿突围。图层：阵边缺口中逃出的车辆。
slope.en: Cao Cao and banners on a hilltop, spear ranks below, a white-robed general breaking through with an infant. Layer: carts escaping through a gap.

fog.zh: 大雾江面，远岸营火。图层：插满箭的草船。
fog.en: Fog on the river, distant campfires. Layer: straw boats bristling with arrows.

fire.zh: 赤壁夜江，铁索连舟。图层：火攻与红天；火船；后营空/后营起火；提灯小舟（接人）；下游未连锁的船。
fire.en: Night river at Red Cliffs, ships chained together. Layers: fire and red sky; fire ships; rear camp empty or burning; a small boat with a lantern (rescue); unchained ships downstream.

huarong.zh: 华容道，两侧峭壁，泥泞小路，残兵队列，一将立马拦路。图层：背药箱的女子在队尾。
huarong.en: Huarong road between cliffs, a muddy path, a column of defeated soldiers, a general blocking the way on horseback. Layer: a woman with a medicine chest at the rear.

campfire.zh: 夜营篝火，帐篷剪影，二人对坐火边，火星飞起。图层：城楼（古城）；横在膝上的刀。
campfire.en: A night camp: a fire with sparks, tent silhouettes, two men seated by the fire. Layers: a city wall (Gucheng); a blade across the knees.

riverbank.zh: 战后夜江，水面漂着焦木，远处余火，江边一名女子洗药杵。图层：身旁一名男子。
riverbank.en: The river at night after battle: charred timbers drifting, distant embers, a woman washing a pestle at the water's edge. Layer: a man beside her.

ending.zh: 尾声：晨江远山，红日。图层：两人同舟；江边茅屋炊烟；城郭；独立江岸；梅枝；远帆。
ending.en: Epilogue: river and mountains at dawn, red sun. Layers: two people in a boat; a cottage with smoke; city walls; a lone figure on the shore; plum branch; distant sail.

citywall.zh: 水墨淡彩，宽幅。城墙与城门，城上旗帜。图层：攻城的长梯与枪林；刘字绿旗或东吴红旗；城门洞开；城下人群；黄昏。
citywall.en: Ink and wash, wide. A city wall and gate with banners. Layers: siege ladders and spears; Liu's green banners or Wu's red; open gate; crowd below; dusk.

temple.zh: 山寺，松树，亭台，主客数人。图层：廊下暗藏的刀斧手；被劈开的石头。
temple.en: Hillside temple, pines, pavilions, a few figures. Layers: axemen hidden in the corridor; a split rock.

bigriver.zh: 大江上一艘大船，船上女子与侍从。图层：小船上的武将；怀中孩子；横江拦截的船队与绿旗；东吴的红旗船。
bigriver.en: A large ship on the river, a woman and attendants aboard. Layers: a general on a small boat; a child; a blockade of boats with green banners; Wu's red-bannered ships.

mourning.zh: 夜，灵堂，白幡，灵位与烛火，一人跪拜。图层：两侧吊客；角落一个相貌古怪的人。
mourning.en: Night, a mourning hall, white banners, spirit tablet and candles, one figure kneeling. Layers: mourners on both sides; an odd-looking man in the corner.

ravine.zh: 竹林夹道的山间小路，一骑白马。图层：箭雨；倒地的随从；勒马回头。
ravine.en: A narrow hill path between bamboo, a rider on a white horse. Layers: a hail of arrows; a fallen companion; the rider turning back.

liubei.zh: 水墨淡彩半身像，四十岁左右的汉室宗亲，面如冠玉，两耳垂肩，短须，小冠，青灰色交领长袍。表情：平静/温和/冷淡/忧伤/吃惊。
liubei.en: Ink-wash bust portrait: an imperial kinsman around forty, fair face, very long earlobes, short beard, small crown, grey-green crossed-collar robe. Expressions: neutral / warm / cold / sad / surprised.

guanyu.zh: 水墨淡彩半身像，面如重枣，丹凤眼，卧蚕眉，长髯过胸，绿头巾，绿袍。表情同上。
guanyu.en: Ink-wash bust portrait: face the deep red of a jujube, phoenix eyes, thick 'silkworm' brows, a beard past the chest, green headscarf and green robe. Same expressions.

caocao.zh: 水墨淡彩半身像，丞相，细眼，长须，高冠，深红黑色官袍。表情同上。
caocao.en: Ink-wash bust portrait: the Chancellor, narrow eyes, long thin beard, tall official hat, dark red-black robe. Same expressions.

zhuge.zh: 水墨淡彩半身像，二十七岁，纶巾，白色鹤氅，手持羽扇，神情从容。表情同上。
zhuge.en: Ink-wash bust portrait: twenty-seven, silk scholar's cap, white crane-feather cloak, feather fan, composed. Same expressions.

wenzhi.zh: 水墨淡彩半身像，原创人物：成年女医者，高髻，金簪，一朵梅花，浅蓝灰衣裙。表情同上，另加害羞。
wenzhi.en: Ink-wash bust portrait, original character: an adult woman physician, high bun, gold hairpin, a plum blossom, pale blue-grey dress. Same expressions plus shy.

zhouyu.zh: 东吴大都督，三十出头，面容俊秀，戴小冠，红色袍服；神情自负。表情：平静、微笑、冷淡、哀伤、吃惊、羞赧。
zhouyu.en: Grand Commander of Wu, early thirties, handsome, small cap, red robes, proud bearing. Moods: neutral, warm, cold, sad, surprised, shy.

lusu.zh: 东吴重臣，中年，短须，忠厚，赭色袍服。
lusu.en: Senior minister of Wu, middle-aged, short beard, honest face, ochre robes.

zhaoyun.zh: 身长八尺，浓眉大眼，阔面重颐（第7回）；银白盔甲，盔顶白缨。
zhaoyun.en: Eight feet tall, thick brows, large eyes, broad face and full jaw (ch. 7); silver-white armour, white plume.

sunfuren.zh: 孙权之妹，成年女子，发髻插金簪红花，红色衣裳，神情刚烈。
sunfuren.en: Sun Quan's sister, an adult woman, hair in a bun with a gold pin and red flowers, red clothes, fierce expression.

pangtong.zh: 浓眉掀鼻，黑面短髯，形容古怪（第57回）；褐色头巾。
pangtong.en: Thick brows, upturned nose, dark face, short beard, odd-looking (ch. 57); brown head scarf.

zhangsong.zh: 额镢头尖，鼻偃齿露，身短不满五尺（第60回）；尖顶小帽。
zhangsong.en: Pointed head, flat nose, protruding teeth, under five feet tall (ch. 60); small pointed cap.

fazheng.zh: 四十岁上下的谋士，面容清瘦，目光锐利，留短须，黑色纶巾，深青色袍服；神情冷静，似笑非笑。
fazheng.en: A strategist around forty, lean face, sharp eyes, short beard, black silk cap, dark teal robes; calm, a half smile.

huangzhong.zh: 年近七十的老将，白发白须，精神矍铄，身材魁梧，金色铠甲，背负大弓，手持大刀；笑容豪爽。
huangzhong.en: A general nearly seventy, white hair and beard, vigorous and broad-shouldered, golden armour, a great bow on his back and a broadsword; a hearty grin.

kept_text.zh: 你答应过温芷的话，你做到了。她没有说什么，只是把你的手握得很紧。
kept_text.en: You kept your word to Wen Zhi. She says nothing—only holds your hand very tightly.

broken_text.zh: 你答应过温芷的话，被你自己拿去换了军报。她再提起这句话时，语气平得像在念药方。
broken_text.en: The promise you made Wen Zhi, you traded for military intelligence. When she mentions it again, her voice is as flat as a prescription.

kept_text.zh: 你答应过温芷的话，你做到了。她没有说什么，只是把你的手握得很紧。
kept_text.en: You kept your word to Wen Zhi. She says nothing—only holds your hand very tightly.

broken_text.zh: 你答应过温芷的话，被你自己拿去换了军报。她再提起这句话时，语气平得像在念药方。
broken_text.en: The promise you made Wen Zhi, you traded for military intelligence. When she mentions it again, her voice is as flat as a prescription.

kept_text.zh: 你对刘备说过不离不弃。一卷走完，你还在他身边。
kept_text.en: You told Liu Bei you'd never leave him. At the end of the volume, you're still at his side.

broken_text.zh: 你对刘备说过不离不弃。后来古城的消息传来，说他听说你留在了曹营，只说了一句：『人各有志。』
broken_text.en: You told Liu Bei you'd never leave him. Word reaches you that when he heard you'd stayed with Cao, he said only: 'Every man chooses his own road.'

kept_text.zh: 你对关羽许过的话，你守住了。在他那里，这比什么都重。
kept_text.en: You kept the word you gave Guan Yu. To him, nothing weighs more.

broken_text.zh: 你对关羽许过的话，没有守住。他再也不跟你喝酒了。
broken_text.en: You broke the word you gave Guan Yu. He never drinks with you again.

kept_text.zh: 你对曹操说过要尽忠。至少到这一卷为止，你做到了。
kept_text.en: You told Cao Cao you'd serve him faithfully. For this volume at least, you did.

broken_text.zh: 你对曹操说过要尽忠，却在长坂坡放走了刘备的家眷。他不知道。你知道。
broken_text.en: You swore loyalty to Cao Cao, then let Liu Bei's people go at Changban. He doesn't know. You do.

rash.zh: 到 6：有人会把你的话报上去
rash.en: At 6: someone reports what you've said

desc.zh: 白帝城里，先帝把你的手和丞相的手放在了一起。
desc.en: In Baidi, the late emperor laid your hand with the Chancellor's.

desc.zh: 那一夜你守在张飞帐外。范疆、张达扔下刀跑了。
desc.en: That night you kept watch outside Zhang Fei's tent. Fan Jiang and Zhang Da dropped their knives and ran.

desc.zh: 永安宫的偏殿里，你和温芷说定了：回成都就成亲。
desc.en: In a side hall of the Palace of Enduring Peace, you and Wen Zhi agreed: back in Chengdu, you'd marry.

desc.zh: 鱼腹浦的石头会动，你早就知道。有人叫你先生，有人叫你妖人。
desc.en: You knew the stones at Yufu Shore would move. Some call you Master; some call you a sorcerer.

desc.zh: 你早早就离开了。白帝城的事，你是从远处听说的。
desc.en: You left early. You heard about Baidi from far away.
